_doc: CH-corpus-clock-contract-v1 (2026-10-08): the MARKET calendar contract — which wall clock defines a trading DAY / WEEK / higher-timeframe grid for an asset class. This is a fact about the MARKET, declared once; it is NOT derived from any broker or corpus clock (broker timestamp timezone and calendar timezone are separate concepts). Canonical timestamps are UTC; a calendar maps UTC to the wall time whose 00:00 starts the market day: wall = local(timezone) + ((24h - day_start) mod 24h). fx_metals: the FX/metals trading day closes at 17:00 America/New_York (D1/H4/W1 grids, PDH/PDL, weekly range, day-of-week all follow it). crypto: the UTC day. The asset class of an instrument comes from the existing classifier dataset_integrity.classify_market (crypto_quote_suffixes); no second list is kept here.
